message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration depicts a man's portrait against a solid tan background, framed by a red border on the left and a red stripe at the bottom. The man is shown from the chest up, oriented toward the right but looking toward the viewer with a closed-eye, wide-toothed smile. He has grey hair and a tan complexion. His right hand is raised in a thumbs-up gesture. He wears a light grey vest over a darker grey shirt. A badge with a gold-colored emblem is pinned to his shirt, partially obscured by the vest. The vest features several pockets and the black and red letters "KPK" on the right chest.

Large white letters "TEMPO" span the upper section, partially behind the man's head. Below this, "14-20 DESEMBER 2015" is printed in small white text. The top edge contains the white text: "BUDI WASESO: KALAU DIPOJOKIN, SAYA BUKA SEMUA". To the right of the man, large black text reads "ADUH RUKI". Below this, a block of smaller black text begins with "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi dilemahkan..." and ends with "...ikut ambil bagian?". A barcode with the numbers "00042" and "9 770126 427302" is in the bottom left corner, alongside the price "RP 39.500".
